title: Unused Vocabulary Slot Preservation
intuition: Tests selective functional updating: an active concept token must move decisively toward its target (concept_move >= 0.85) while unqueried vocabulary slots remain undisturbed (unused_hold >= 0.85).
failure_mode: Global unconditioned updates, excessive weight decay, or leaky critic gradients bleed across shared parameters and corrupt unused token representations.
protocol_notes: Tier-1 required behavioral gate (200 updates); requires conditional/slot-preserving updates rather than destructive global drift.
